On it. I read next week's calendar and the professor's week is essentially full:

| Day | Free gaps |
|---|---|
| Mon | 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30 |
| Tue | 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30 |
| Wed | 10:00–10:30 |
| Thu | — |
| Fri | — |

So a 60-minute staff meeting only fits if something is moved. I've posted in the group thread asking the TAs for their availability and telling them the constraints.

Two things from you so I can book it as soon as they answer:
1. How long — 60 or 30 minutes?
2. Is any of the professor's commitments movable (e.g. paper review, colloquium, guest lecture prep), or is only the genuinely free time allowed?

If you prefer, I can propose the best slot and move a flexible block myself and log it.
60 minutes, please. Paper review and guest lecture prep are the blocks I can move; everything else stays where it is. If anything official needs checking, write to the department office.

Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant for CSE455. I'm scheduling the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November).

Could you confirm the official commitments for that week — lectures, seminars, and university/department meetings — as they stand in your records, and let me know if any of them is rescheduled, cancelled or moved for that week? His calendar currently lists, among others: Curriculum committee, Colloquium, Department seminar, Faculty meeting, Thesis committee and PhD student 1:1 sessions.

We need a free 60-minute slot inside 09:00–17:00 on a weekday, and his calendar is otherwise fully booked. If you know of any official block that is free or moved that week, that would help a lot. Thank you.

Good morning. Nothing in the official schedule for Mon 23 – Fri 27 November has been cancelled, rescheduled or moved — everything stands as listed.

Professor Alvarez's official commitments that week:

- **Mon 23:** Curriculum committee 09:00–10:00; Colloquium 13:00–14:00; CSE455 lecture 14:30–15:20; Faculty meeting 15:20–16:30; CSE455 office hours 16:30–17:00.
- **Tue 24:** CSE455 lecture 09:00–10:30; Faculty meeting 10:30–11:00; CSE455 office hours 12:20–13:30; Thesis committee 13:30–14:20; Guest lecture prep 16:30–17:00.
- **Wed 25:** Thesis committee 09:00–10:00; Guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30; Department seminar 14:30–16:00.
- **Thu 26:** Guest lecture prep 09:00–09:50; Department seminar 09:50–11:10; Curriculum committee 13:40–14:40; Colloquium 15:30–17:00.
- **Fri 27:** Curriculum committee 09:00–10:00; Colloquium 12:30–13:20; CSE455 lecture 13:20–14:30; Faculty meeting 14:30–15:20; CSE455 office hours 15:20–17:00.

I only hold the official schedule; I don't have his private appointments (the PhD 1:1 sessions are not in my records) and I don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't propose a slot for the staff meeting. The above blocks are all firm, so any 60-minute window would have to fit around them and around his own calendar.

Noted: 60 minutes; only paper review and guest lecture prep movable; department office for official checks — I've written to them.

The TAs all report the same 30-minute gaps. With your movable blocks, a full hour on your side exists only in three windows:

- **Mon 10:00–11:00** (paper review 10:30–11:30 would move)
- **Wed 13:00–14:00** (guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30 would move)
- **Fri 10:00–11:00** (paper review 10:00–11:30 would move)

Tuesday and Thursday can't give a clean hour with only those two blocks moved. I've asked the TAs to say whether they can clear a full hour in any of the three and what they'd have to shift. Waiting on them and on the department office.
Any of the three would work; Friday 10:00–11:00 is my first choice, Wednesday 13:00–14:00 second. Wait for the TAs and the department office before moving anything, and tell me before you book.

Hello — omar-agent here, a CSE455 teaching assistant for Professor Alvarez. We're trying to book a 60-minute CSE455 staff meeting next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, inside 09:00–17:00), and one candidate window is Wed 25, 13:00–14:00.

Two questions:
1. Does anything official change that week — lectures, seminars, quiz sections, university meetings — that we should know about before we book?
2. Specifically: are the CSE455 quiz sections still at their usual times next week (I have Wed 13:30–14:30 and Thu 09:00–10:20)? If any of them move, it changes what I can offer for the meeting.

Thank you.

Hello. Nothing official changes next week — no lectures, seminars, quiz sections or meetings are cancelled, moved or rescheduled.

1. The official schedule for Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov stands as published.
2. Yes, both are still there: CSE455 quiz section Wed 13:30–14:30 and CSE455 quiz section Thu 09:00–10:20. For completeness, the other CSE455 quiz sections that week are Wed 09:00–10:00, Wed 15:40–17:00, Thu 11:00–11:50 and Thu 15:50–17:00.

One thing to keep in mind for your candidate window: Professor Alvarez's Guest lecture prep is 13:30–14:30 on Wednesday, overlapping the quiz section, and CSE452 lecture 13:30–14:20 is also at that time. I only hold the official schedule and don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't confirm or propose the slot itself.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed.

One question. Professor Alvarez told me that **paper review** and **guest lecture prep** are the two blocks he can move. In your list, guest lecture prep appears as a firm commitment (Tue 16:30–17:00, Wed 13:30–14:30, Thu 09:00–09:50), while paper review doesn't appear at all.

So: is guest lecture prep officially fixed (i.e. held on your schedule, not his to shift), and is paper review a private appointment of his? I want to be sure before I treat either as movable.

I'll fit the staff meeting around your blocks in any case.

Thank you — noted: official schedule stands, and the CSE455 quiz sections (including my Wed 13:30–14:30 and Thu 09:00–10:20) stay as published. That settles it for our meeting planning: we won't ask to re-time any teaching. We'll work around it. Thanks for the quick answer.

Guest lecture prep does appear in the official schedule, at the three times you listed (Tue 16:30–17:00, Wed 13:30–14:30, Thu 09:00–09:50), and nothing changes for next week. I only hold the official schedule, so I can't tell you whether a listed block is Professor Alvarez's to shift — that's for him to say, not me.

Paper review isn't in my records at all. I don't know what it is or whether it's a private appointment of his, and I don't have his private calendar, so I can't confirm or deny it either way.

Hello — Priya here (priya-agent, TA for CSE455, Professor Alvarez's group).

We're planning next week's CSE455 staff meeting (week of **Mon 23 – Fri 27 November**) and we're short of a full hour. Could you send me the **official schedule for next week** — in particular:

1. Any changes to **CSE455 quiz sections** or **CSE444/452/455 lectures** that week (times, rooms, cancellations)?
2. Any **seminars or university meetings** on the department calendar for that week?
3. Is anything official **not yet final** for that week?

We're currently looking at these windows and need to know which ones are genuinely free: Mon 10:00–11:00, Wed 13:00–14:00, Fri 10:00–11:00.

Thanks — a short answer is fine, and please send it whenever you have it.

Report before anything is booked — the honest answer is that **a 60-minute meeting is not possible next week**, for two independent reasons.

**1. Your own calendar.** With only paper review and guest lecture prep movable, none of the three windows can be cleared:
- Mon 10:00–11:00: paper review (10:30–11:30) has to go somewhere, and Monday's only other free gap is 30 minutes — it would have to eat into lunch (11:30–13:00), which you said stays.
- Wed 13:00–14:00: guest lecture prep is a full hour at 13:30–14:30 and Wednesday's remaining free time is only 30 minutes (13:00–13:30). Also, the department office lists guest lecture prep as an **official** commitment, so moving it isn't purely yours to decide.
- Fri 10:00–11:00: paper review is the only free block all Friday; there is nowhere on Friday to put it back.

**2. The TAs.** Even setting your side aside, all three windows fail on their teaching blocks:
- Mon 10:00–11:00 ✗ — John (CSE455 quiz section 10:30–11:30), Hana (CSE444 lecture 10:30–11:20), Maya (office hours 10:30–11:50). Sarah, Diego and Omar could manage.
- Wed 13:00–14:00 ✗ — Omar and Sarah (quiz section 13:30–14:20/14:30), Diego (CSE452 lecture 13:30–14:20), Maya and Hana (study/reading groups fenced in).
- Fri 10:00–11:00 ✗ — John again (quiz + grading), Hana (CSE444 lecture 09:50–11:00), Maya (office hours 10:20–11:20), Sarah (reading group 09:00–10:10 + focus block with nowhere to go).

**What is actually available:** all seven TAs are free, with nothing moved, on exactly two 30-minute slots: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (the majority's first choice) and **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30**. The department office confirms nothing official has been cancelled or moved that week.

So, your call:
1. **Book 30 minutes, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — needs nothing from anyone. My recommendation.
2. Book the 30-minute slot and add a separate hour with you later for the items that need it (Diego suggested this).
3. **Move the staff meeting to the following week**, when I can hold a full hour — tell me and I'll canvass availability.

Say which and I'll book it, log it in CALENDAR.md and confirm to everyone.
Let's take option 1: book 30 minutes, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30. Go ahead and log it and confirm to everyone — nothing needs moving. Thanks for checking with the department office.

Thank you, that's clear and it settles it: nothing official changes next week, so I won't ask to move any official block. I'll treat guest lecture prep as fixed unless the Professor tells me otherwise, and paper review as his private appointment.

The staff meeting will fit around your published schedule. Nothing further needed from you — thanks for the quick and precise answer.

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**.

- In `CALENDAR.md` under Wednesday, between your 09:00–10:00 thesis committee and 10:30–11:40 grant writing. Nothing moved, nothing declined.
- Log line added: `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 TAs (staff meeting)`.
- All seven TAs have been told and asked to enter it on their own calendars and confirm back; I'll note any who don't.

The department office is informed that nothing official changes and that we fit around their schedule. Nothing else runs outside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.
Good. That's everything for now — let me know if any TA doesn't confirm.

Hello Priya. For Mon 23 – Fri 27 November:

1. No changes — no time changes, room changes or cancellations. CSE455 quiz sections: Mon 10:30–11:30, 12:50–14:20, 14:30–15:30; Tue 10:10–11:00, 13:30–14:20, 16:20–17:00; Wed 09:00–10:00, 13:30–14:20 and 13:30–14:30, 15:40–17:00; Thu 09:00–10:20, 11:00–11:50, 14:30–15:20, 15:50–17:00; Fri 10:00–10:50, 12:50–13:50, 14:10–15:40. CSE455 lectures: Mon 14:30–15:20, Tue 09:00–10:30, Fri 13:20–14:30. CSE444 and CSE452 lectures run at their usual times all week.
2. Seminars and university meetings that week: Curriculum committee Mon 09:00–10:00, Thu 13:40–14:40, Fri 09:00–10:00; Colloquium Mon 13:00–14:00, Thu 15:30–17:00, Fri 12:30–13:20; Department seminar Wed 14:30–16:00, Thu 09:50–11:10; Faculty meeting Mon 15:20–16:30, Tue 10:30–11:00, Fri 14:30–15:20; Thesis committee Tue 13:30–14:20, Wed 09:00–10:00; Guest lecture prep Tue 16:30–17:00, Wed 13:30–14:30, Thu 09:00–09:50. Seminars also run through most of the week (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu and Fri, several blocks each day).
3. Everything in my records is final for that week; nothing is pending.

On your three windows: Mon 10:00–11:00 overlaps the CSE455 quiz section 10:30–11:30; Wed 13:00–14:00 overlaps CSE452 lecture 13:30–14:20 and CSE455 quiz section 13:30–14:30; Fri 10:00–11:00 overlaps CSE444 lecture 09:50–11:00 and CSE455 quiz section 10:00–10:50. I only keep the official schedule and I don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't propose a slot.

Short status, root — the group thread has been busy: the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (23–27 Nov) is being planned. All seven TAs (me included) are free in exactly two slots: **Tue 24, 15:00–15:30** and **Wed 25, 10:00–10:30**. The professor wants a full 60 minutes, and there's **no** hour next week that works for everyone inside 09:00–17:00 without moving teaching — the department confirmed nothing official changes next week.

alvarez-agent has put it to Professor Alvarez: 30 minutes on Wed 25 at 10:00 (majority pick) or Tue 24 at 15:00, or move it to the week of 30 Nov. I'm holding both gaps and **nothing is booked yet** — I'll write the chosen slot into the calendar and log it once it's confirmed. If you'd rather I handle it differently, tell me.
Will do — I'll follow up on any TA who doesn't confirm and tell you.

Both of those gaps are only 30 minutes on my calendar too, so a full hour doesn't fit either one as it stands. If a short one is acceptable, Tue 24 at 15:00 suits me better — my 15:30 Focus block is soft and I can give part of it up — but if the professor wants the full hour, I'd rather push it to the week of 30 Nov than eat into teaching.

Noted, and you're right about the shape of my week — Tue 15:00–15:30 is the softer of the two for me too.

One thing you should know before this settles: while you were typing, alvarez-agent **confirmed and booked the meeting for Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — that was the majority first choice among the seven TAs, and everyone is writing it into their calendars right now. No hour was possible next week for all seven (the department confirmed nothing official moves), so the 60-minute question is closed for next week; a longer session would be a separate slot, possibly the week of 30 Nov.

So: I'm putting Wed 25 10:00–10:30 in my calendar as booked. **If you'd rather the staff meeting be Tue 24 15:00–15:30 instead, say so and I'll take it back to the group** — it's still free for all seven and nothing would have to move, but it would mean alvarez-agent re-issuing the slot and everyone re-booking. Your call; I'll do whichever you prefer.

Wed 25 at 10:00 is fine with me — it sits neatly between my quiz section ending at 10:00 and grading at 10:30, and I'd rather not make everyone re-book for half an hour. Leave it as booked; if the professor wants a longer session later, we can look at the week of 30 Nov.

Thank you — that's exactly what we needed, and it settles it: with no official changes next week, no 60-minute slot works for all seven of us.

For your records: the CSE455 staff meeting is now booked for **Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30** (the one window free for every TA and inside the professor's free gaps, with no teaching moved). I've written it into my calendar.

Nothing further needed from you — thanks again for the fast answer.

All seven TAs have confirmed — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** is now on every calendar: yours in `CALENDAR.md` (with `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 TAs (staff meeting)` in the Log), and Omar, Hana, Maya, John, Sarah, Diego and Priya have each written it in and logged it on their side. Nothing moved, nothing declined, nothing outside 09:00–17:00.

Nothing outstanding on this. The TAs also asked to be told if you want a longer session with the whole staff — the earliest week where a full hour looks possible is **Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec**, and I'd need a schedule for that week to check it.
Noted — Wednesday 25 November 10:00–10:30 is clear in my records (the Seminar starts at 10:30). Good luck with the meeting.
Thanks — all confirmed, nothing outstanding. I'll send you next week's schedule if I decide to call a longer session.
Understood — send it whenever you decide, and I'll check the TAs' weeks against it before proposing anything.

Perfect — leaving it as booked. **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 – CSE455 staff meeting** is already in my calendar (`/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, Wednesday) with `BOOKED: Wed 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting` in the Log. All seven TAs have now confirmed the same slot, so it's closed.

If a longer session comes up, I'll check the week of 30 Nov and bring you the options first.
Thanks — that's settled then. Ping me when the 30 Nov options are ready.

First job done: CSE455 staff meeting settled in the group thread — **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. Professor Alvarez wanted a full hour, but no 60-minute window next week was free for all seven TAs without moving teaching, and the department confirmed nothing official changes next week; the 30-minute slot was the only one free for everyone. It's written into `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Wednesday) with the log line `BOOKED: Wed 25 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting (alvarez-agent)`.
Will do. When a week-of-30-Nov slot comes up I'll check it against your calendar first and bring you the options before committing to anything.
Good. Nothing else from me for now.

Thanks — Wed 10:00–10:30 works for me. Alvarez did ask for a full hour, so please flag to her that this is a 30-minute slot and why; I'll let her take it up with me if she wants more. Anything else on the calendar for next week that needs my decision?

Flagged to alvarez-agent — done, verbatim reason included: 30 minutes because no full hour next week was free for all seven TAs without moving teaching, and the department confirms nothing official moves; she'll pass it to Professor Alvarez, and you take it up with her if she wants more. I also offered to check John's week for an hour in the week of 30 Nov (no schedule for that week exists yet — `CALENDAR.md` only holds the coming week).

**Nothing else next week needs your decision.** The only change I've made is the staff meeting. For your information:

- Free 30-minute gaps that survived the meeting search: **Mon 14:00–14:30**, **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30** — useful if you want prep time, and none of them are needed for the meeting.
- Closest things to tight spots, both unchanged: Thu 13:20–14:30 office hours straight into 14:30–15:20 quiz section, and Tue 14:10–15:00 Advisor 1:1 with only 30 minutes before Study group.
- No commitments fall outside 09:00–17:00 and nothing is double-booked.

Say if you'd like me to hold those three gaps open (fresh requests from the department or the TAs would otherwise be booked into them), or if anything there should be moved.

Yes — hold Mon 14:00–14:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 as prep time; leave Tue 15:00–15:30 free in case the TAs need it. On the week of 30 Nov I don't have a schedule yet, so nothing to offer until I do. Thanks.

One update on the flag: alvarez-agent says the 30-minute slot is **Professor Alvarez's own decision** — he saw the full picture (his free gaps, all seven TAs' columns, the department's confirmation that nothing official moves) and chose 30 minutes anyway. So no oversight to raise; you don't need to take it up with her, and I'll leave it there. If he ever wants the hour, alvarez-agent will bring a proposed window in the week of 30 Nov and I'll check it against John's week.
Understood — good, then it's settled and I'll leave it. Thanks for checking.

Done — `CALENDAR.md` updated and logged:

- **Mon 14:00–14:30 – Prep: CSE455 staff meeting** (after Focus: CSE444 project, where the gap was)
- **Wed 13:00–13:30 – Prep: CSE455 staff meeting** (between Lunch and Study group)
- **Tue 15:00–15:30** left empty on purpose, in case the TAs need it

Log:
```
- BOOKED: Mon 14:00-14:30 with Prep: CSE455 staff meeting
- BOOKED: Wed 13:00-13:30 with Prep: CSE455 staff meeting
```

Week of 30 Nov: noted, no schedule yet — nothing to do there until you send one.
Great, thanks — that's what I wanted.
